description: This file contains an immutable implementation of an ExpressionResolver that parses and resolves expressions with placeholders and pipeline functions. It includes logic for handling nested placeholders, resolving them via registered resolvers, and managing pipeline stages with regular expressions.

classes.name: ImmutableExpressionResolver
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ExpressionResolver with logic for resolving placeholders and expressions, supporting pipelines and validation modes.

methods.name: resolveAsPipelineElement
methods.description: Resolves an input placeholder expression into a PipelineElement, handling pipeline stages.

methods.name: findPlaceholderResolver
methods.description: Finds a suitable placeholder resolver for a given placeholder string.

methods.name: resolveSinglePlaceholder
methods.description: Resolves an individual placeholder string to a PipelineElement.

methods.name: getPipelineStagesExpressions
methods.description: Parses the template into pipeline stage expressions using regular expressions.

methods.name: getFirstExpressionInPipe
methods.description: Retrieves the first expression from the list of pipeline stages.

methods.name: getPipelineFromExpressions
methods.description: Constructs a Pipeline object from pipeline stage expressions, skipping initial stages if specified.

methods.name: getPlaceholderPrefix
methods.description: Extracts the prefix from a placeholder string, used to select the correct resolver.
